scripts.migrate:up: node-pg-migrate up -d PG_URL -m src/migrations -j js -t pgmigrations
scripts.migrate:down: node-pg-migrate down -d PG_URL -m src/migrations -j js -t pgmigrations
scripts.migrate:new: node-pg-migrate create -d PG_URL -m src/migrations -j js -t pgmigrations
